title: send
summary: Write a web Response to a Node ServerResponse.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Pass response and the outgoing Node response.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns Promise<void> after buffering and sending the response body.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Write a web Response to a Node ServerResponse.

sections.title: Behavior and limits
sections.body: Preserves status, headers and multiple Set-Cookie headers. Secure cookies are relaxed for local non-production HTTP. This helper does not stream; errors propagate to the caller.
